english.title: Project missile manually / artificially in Trafalgar Square
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), within Trafalgar Square, other than acting in accordance with permission given in writing by the Mayor or a person authorised by the Mayor to give such permission, projected a missile, namely **(..SPECIFY MISSILE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 5(1)(g) of the Trafalgar Square Byelaws 2012 and section 385(3)(b) of the Greater London Authority Act 1999.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes: (i) As per byelaw 5(1), unless acting in accordance with permission given in writing by the Mayor , or any person authorised by the Mayor under section 380 of the Act to give such permission, no person shall within the Square carry out any acts covered in byelaws 5(1)(a) to 5(1)(w).(ii) As per byelaw 9, where an authorised person has reasonable ground for belief that a person has contravened any one or more of the Byelaws, that person shall give on demand his name and address to that authorised person.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant, within Trafalgar Square, without the written permission of the Mayor or a person authorised by the Mayor to give such permission, projected a missile, namely **(..SPECIFY MISSILE..).
